text: Microbiology is an important basic branch in the life science domain, which studies the laws of microorganisms' biological activities and their connections with nature. With the development of molecular biology, the study of Microbiology has entered the period of molecular biology research, and become one of its important forward disciplines, embodying the general direction. The Doctor of Microbiology program was authorized in 2000. There are 6 research fields, including molecular biological nitrogen fixation and gene engineering, molecular virology and gene engineering, microbial biotechnology, food microbiology, making use of microoganism resources.
